plan.title: Tear down orphaned TS-vs-Python parity harnesses (#2083)

narratives.Description: Follow-up carved out of #1860. The 44 packages/cli/src/*-parity.ts harnesses spawned the now-deleted frozen Python oracle to golden-diff TS output. With Python gone the comparison is dead code; remove the harness source, preserving any fixtures/helpers that real (non-parity) unit tests still import.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Pure-delete the 11 parity .ts files with zero test importers.
- Delete-pair: remove the ~22 parity .ts files whose ONLY importer is their own *-parity.test.ts, plus that test (the test only covers the harness's pure helpers, which vitest.config excludes from coverage).
- Extract+repoint: for the ~12 parity .ts files whose fixtures/helpers are imported by REAL non-parity tests, move the reused exports into a non-parity *-fixtures.ts module, repoint the importing tests, then delete the parity .ts.
- Clean the *-parity.ts entries from vitest.config.ts coverage exclude list.
- Confirm zero python / uv run / .py references remain in packages/.
- Keep task check green; restore the vitest branch threshold toward 85% if the denominator shift allows.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft maintainer, I want the dead Python-parity harnesses gone so packages/ carries no references to the deleted Python runtime and the TS unit suite is the sole source of truth.

items.title: Given the parity harnesses, when teardown lands, then every packages/cli/src/*-parity.ts source file is removed.

narrative.Acceptance: No packages/cli/src/*-parity.ts files remain; zero python/uv run/.py references in packages/.

items.title: Given real tests that imported parity fixtures, when the parity source is deleted, then those tests still pass against extracted non-parity fixture modules.

narrative.Acceptance: All previously-passing non-parity tests still pass; reused fixtures live in non-parity modules.

items.title: Given the teardown, when task check runs, then it passes with the parity entries removed from the vitest coverage exclude list.

narrative.Acceptance: task check exits 0; vitest.config.ts no longer lists deleted *-parity.ts files.
